outlook.statement: The company maintains a satisfactory order book position, and there have been no alterations in the nature of the company's business.
50% of the newly added capacity will be continuously utilized keeping in view the demand for the product in both international and domestic markets and continuing to grow at a steady rate.

The Company remains focused on leveraging its established product portfolio and manufacturing capabilities to build a diversified and sustainable revenue base. Subject to market conditions and availability of resources, the Company will evaluate opportunities to expand its product lines, develop downstream derivatives of existing products and strengthen backward integration to reduce external dependencies. While near-term global markets remain affected by geopolitical and trade-related uncertainties, the Company remains cautiously optimistic about medium to long-term demand and will continue to focus on operational efficiency, customer engagement and disciplined growth.

In the next 12 months, we aim to replace any outdated equipment with energy-efficient ones. Furthermore, we are committed to incorporating cleaner sources of energy in our operations. For the same, we are in the process of setting up solar/ wind energy and Green Hydrogen plant.
In the next year, we aim to reduce water footprint by implementing immediate water-saving measures and processes. In addition, we are also looking at implementing water recycling measures.

We are working on developing mechanisms to ensure the waste is utilized for coprocessing and other reclamation processes by other industry partners. In addition, we will be conducting periodic waste audits to see how we can improve our processes.
The Company plans to assess suppliers for sustainable sourcing.
In the next six months, we are also looking at implementing water saving measures, as well as process optimization. We are also looking at implementing water recycling systems.

The medium- to long-term outlook for the Indian chemical industry remains supported by domestic demand, import-substitution opportunities and diversification of global supply chains. The Company's diversified product portfolio, manufacturing experience and established customer relationships provide a foundation for future growth. Management remains focused on improving utilisation, cost efficiency and customer engagement. The near-term environment, however, remains affected by geopolitical uncertainty, changing trade conditions, aggressive overseas pricing and volatile input costs. Subject to improvement in market conditions, the Company expects its operational and cost-efficiency initiatives to support improved performance.
The Company expects improvements in subsequent periods as operational stability returns and wider market conditions become more predictable.

The Company shall strongly endeavour to meet its past CSR spending obligations by transferring the amount of Rs. 218.19 Lakhs to the funds prescribed under Schedule VII of the Companies Act at the earliest possible.
The Company has received and continues to have executable business orders and contracts which are expected to generate adequate future cash inflows.
Exports have started picking up from April'26 onwards.
The directors opined that, barring unforeseen circumstances the performance of company is expected to improve in the current financial year.
